title: Brand24 Review (2026)
intro: Brand24 is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Brand24 monitors online mentions across 25M+ sources for reputation protection, awareness measurement, competitor analysis, and customer insights with sentiment and reporting. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Brand24 when social listening, reputation monitoring, and mention analytics are the primary job — not scheduling or funnels.
verdict: Choose Brand24 when social listening, reputation monitoring, and mention analytics are the primary job — not scheduling or funnels. Compare SocialBee for posting/scheduling, Meltwater/Brandwatch-class suites for enterprise listening, and NiceJob-class tools for review generation. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Listening dashboards are approachable for PR/marketing teams; keyword/mention model needs onboarding but is standard for the category.
Not a content/scheduling product — low score by design versus SocialBee.
Monitoring/alerts are not marketing automation journeys — low by design.
No funnel/landing tooling — lowest conversion score among this wave.
Reach, awareness, sentiment, and reporting are first-party strengths for monitoring programs.
Core product job — social listening across 25M+ sources with sentiment and AI assistant; highest criterion score.
Slack/API/MCP documented; broader marketing-stack connectors are secondary to listening.
Mention/keyword ladders to Business/Enterprise support scale; caps are explicit.
Starts ~$199–$249/mo — premium vs schedulers; fair for listening specialists but pricey for light monitoring needs.
AI Brand Assistant and sentiment are marketed; not an AI content studio.

notIdealFor: Users who only need to schedule social posts
